story: Show HN: Corral – A Serverless MapReduce Framework
text: They use a lot of AWS services - not just virtual machines - First they use Ubuntu Linux - SES (Email) - ElasticSearch (AWS has their own managed version) - SQS (queueing system) - S3 (storage) -auto scaling Most of the optimization's they do are standard things at scale where they are tuning by measuring performance. [VIDEO] and the slide deck from the presentation. [LINK] But that's even more of a reason to choose AWS, Netflix has open sourced dozens of tools specifically related to AWS. You get to take advantage of their tools and knowledge.

story: The creation of the io.latency block I/O controller
